_comment: C0-12 make bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（zapier），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: AI modules reach each vendor's models through the platform (OpenAI and other connectors); the specific list has not been verified item by item. The main axis remains visual scenario orchestration — AI is one of the modules.
axes.runtime: Pure cloud hosting: scenarios run on Make's cloud execution engine; no official statement of a self-hosted form. Execution history and queues all live inside the platform.
axes.local_files: It hosts no local-file runtime; data flows between SaaS services via modules and temporary files are processed in the cloud. The "AI reads/writes local files" form does not exist here (recorded honestly).
axes.background: Cloud-hosted residency is the default form: scheduled timing, webhook triggers and error-retry queues are all native official capabilities — scenarios keep running when your laptop is off; that is the essential difference between hosted and self-hosted forms.
axes.tools: The module (apps) ecosystem is the core asset (official framing: thousands of integrations, not verified item by item); MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: In-scenario data routing and iterators are the official context-organization scheme; cross-scenario memory not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Team/organization roles and the credentials vault are the official permission surface; enterprise-compliance claims not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: visual flowchart-style automation; complex branching/iteration logic reads more directly than form-style tools. Does not fit: self-hosting; wanting AI to be the product's main axis (automation is its identity).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The model catalog connected by AI modules (not verified item by item)
- The current official integration-count framing (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (no official documentation found)
related: Form-style vs flowchart-style contrast: both connector-ecosystem automation — canvas expressiveness is the divide.
